field_definitions.category: Governed products.query_category; one category per barcode in this release
field_definitions.physically_valid: Stored include_in_product_table=1, consistent with nutrition_quality_status != data_quality_error
field_definitions.nutrition_complete: Physically valid with all eight working nutrition fields non-NULL; zero is present
field_definitions.nutrition_incomplete: Physically valid with at least one of eight working nutrition fields NULL
field_definitions.nutrition_warning_present: Physically valid with warning_flag or nonempty warning_types; warnings do not exclude
field_definitions.image_available: Stage 09 structural HTTP(S) URL check, excluding missing and /invalid/ placeholders; no network preflight
field_definitions.historical_ocr_status: Derived from claim_freshness.prior_analysis_json saved before current-release masking; not a claim-freshness certification
field_definitions.claim_freshness_status: Release audit link to extraction evidence; does not by itself determine prior processing

validation_rules: Completed October 18 release with September 29 cutoff and October 17 retrieval
Retained deployment scope, not release_population or legacy MAX(ingested_at)
Locked Stage 03 hard gate reused from stored governed fields; no new physical thresholds
No complete-nutrition, warning, image, or claim-status exclusion from candidate_population
No image downloads, HTTP checks, OCR/LLM, imputation, clustering or source writes
